scope: Complete appearance defaults, separate from material-only palette buttons
decision: Defaults are candidates until real rendered QA. Preference learning is authorized and enabled locally; manual overrides win. Accessibility preferences never inferred from aesthetics.

presets.name: ROSI / familiar
presets.rationale: Pinned ROSI v0.3 uses green-warm dark surfaces, Coherent Verdant accent and no photographic ground. Use a manual green accent rather than the Field split complement; balanced geometry approximates its 8/12/16/24px family. A rendered fit is required; this is not token equivalence.
presets.status: Candidate for rendered contrast and visual review; no popularity claim

palette_fit.scope: Bounded rendered palette fit, not token or component equivalence

presets.name: Quiet / graphite
presets.rationale: Neutral surfaces, independent green signal and no image reduce visual competition. Geometry and semantic contrast remain unchanged.
presets.status: Candidate for rendered contrast and visual review; no popularity claim

presets.name: Field / verdant
presets.rationale: Related green material voices, restrained photograph and a split-complement accent show the extension without maximum saturation.
presets.status: Candidate for rendered contrast and visual review; no popularity claim

presets.name: Field / daylight
presets.rationale: Lower material chroma and restrained canvas presence keep dark reading ink clear; light-mode contrast must be measured.
presets.status: Candidate for rendered contrast and visual review; no popularity claim
